strain: Cntnap2 knockout (JAX017482) on C57BL/6J background; isogenic Cntnap2+/+ wild-type and Cntnap2+/- heterozygous mice from the same colony

age.evidence: 8-10 weeks old mice of both genders were used for behavioural experiments.

sex.evidence: 8-10 weeks old mice of both genders were used for behavioural experiments. Male and female mice of the same genotype were first analysed separately to assess potential sex-related differences in behaviours in our dataset.

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (Usona Institute US) was dissolved in sterile saline solution (0.9% NaCl)... 8-week old offspring were intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg) 24 hours prior to behavioural testing.

MDL was first dissolved in 10% DMSO then diluted using saline. One dose of 1 mg/kg MDL or vehicle was systemically administered via intraperitoneal injections per test animal at 15 min prior to psilocybin or saline treatment.

group_housing.evidence: housed in groups of up to five animals per cage after weaning... Mice were group-housed where possible, with the same littermate mice both before and after treatments.

day_night_flipped.evidence: on a 12/12 h light/dark cycle (light on between 07:00 and 19:00)... All experiments were conducted during the light phase.

assays.assay_description: Custom Plexiglass three-chamber box (60x40x22 cm; three 20x40x22 cm chambers connected by 4x4 cm doors), acrylic floor, transparent slotted cylinders as cups. After 3 days of 10-min habituation and a 10-min empty-chamber phase, the test mouse explored for 10 min with an unfamiliar sex-matched mouse in one cup vs an empty cup. Measures: sociability index, total interaction time (manual scoring of sniffing/exploring cup), locomotion. Tested 1 day, 1 week and 2 weeks after a single 1 mg/kg i.p. psilocybin dose across cohorts (Cntnap2 KO, WT, heterozygous, independent 2-week cohort, MDL100907 pretreatment, treatment under isoflurane anaesthesia).

application_type.evidence: 8-week old offspring were intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg); MDL100907 also given via intraperitoneal injections

setup_habituation.evidence: Each test mouse was placed into the centre chamber and allowed to freely explore and habituate to the three-chamber setup for 10 minutes over 3 consecutive days

setup_restrain.evidence: The test mouse was then allowed to freely explore chambers for 10 min.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the three-chamber apparatus; home cage 'Water and food were provided ad libitum.'

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the three-chamber apparatus; home cage 'Water and food were provided ad libitum.'

time_to_assay.evidence: we assessed the social behaviour of these mice using the three-chamber social behaviour test at 1 day, and also at 1 week and 2 weeks after the single injection

sample_size.evidence: N = 15 for Cntnap2 -/- Psilocybin, 15 for Cntnap2 -/- Vehicle (Fig. 1c); N = 10 / 9 (Fig. 1d); N = 7 / 11 (Fig. 2); N = 10, 10, 9, 9, 7 (Fig. 4a); N = 8 for Cntnap2 -/- Psilocybin, 6 for Cntnap2 +/+ Vehicle (Fig. 5); heterozygous cohort n not given

outcomes.summary: A single 1 mg/kg psilocybin injection increased sociability in Cntnap2 -/- KO mice at 1 day, 1 week and 2 weeks, restoring it to wild-type levels, without changing total interaction time or locomotion. No enhancement occurred in WT or heterozygous mice (WT showed reduced sociability at 1 day). The effect was blocked by MDL100907 pretreatment and was preserved when psilocybin was given under isoflurane anaesthesia.
outcomes.statistics: RMANOVA F2/15 = 544.501, p < 0.001; measures x session F4/13 = 8.763, p = 0.001; sex F1/16 = 0.347, p = 0.564; sociability F1/16 = 9.144, p = 0.008; 1 day F1/26 = 6.826, p = 0.015; 1 week F1/26 = 27.366, p < 0.001; 2 weeks F1/26 = 4.217, p = 0.050 (Bonferroni); independent cohort T = 2.243, p = 0.019; WT RMANOVA F2/15 = 1.970, p = 0.174; pretreatment x treatment F1/34 = 14.751, p < 0.001; anaesthesia RMANOVA F1/10 = 10.629, p = 0.009
outcomes.evidence: The significant increase in sociability of psilocybin-treated Cntnap2 -/- KO group compared to the vehicle-treated Cntnap2 -/- KO control group was sustained for at least two weeks following the single psilocybin administration

B1_num_measures.evidence: combining sociability, total interaction time, and locomotion of the test mice during the testing session

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Interaction durations summed over the 10-min session; no within-session time course reported

B4_ethological.evidence: we manually quantified the actual interaction duration of the test mouse with the cup, quantified as either sniffing or exploring the cup

B5_social.evidence: an age-, size-, and gendermatched unfamiliar non-littermate mouse (S) was placed into a cup in one side chamber, and an empty cup (C) was placed in the opposite side chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate social preference test; no learning or memory requirement

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Video recordings were used to track the position of the body of the animal in each chamber, as well as to manually time the duration of the test mouse's social exploratory behaviour by a blinded, well-trained observer

B8_multivariate.evidence: RMANOVA with follow-up univariate analyses; no dimensionality reduction or clustering

assays.assay_description: Immediately after i.p. psilocybin or saline, mice were placed in a customised 40x20x20 cm box with clean bedding and head twitches counted by direct observation in 5-min bins for 20 min. Included KO vs WT comparison and MDL100907 pretreatment.

application_type.evidence: Head-twitch events were evaluated immediately after intraperitoneal administration of either saline or psilocybin

setup_restrain.evidence: The mouse was placed into a customised behavioural box immediately after injection and was free to explore.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the behavioural box

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the behavioural box

time_to_assay.evidence: Head-twitch events were evaluated immediately after intraperitoneal administration of either saline or psilocybin for a period of 20 minutes.

sample_size.evidence: N = 10 for Cntnap2 -/- Vehicle+Psilocybin, 10 for Cntnap2 -/- Vehicle+Vehicle, 9 for Cntnap2 -/- Ant-5HT2AR+Psilocybin, 9 for Cntnap2 -/- Ant-5HT2AR+Vehicle (Fig. 4b); additional KO vs WT comparison reported (F1/18)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin robustly increased head twitches in Cntnap2 -/- KO mice, with no difference between KO and WT and no sex effect. MDL100907 abolished the psilocybin-induced HTR. HTR did not correlate with later sociability. No HTR was observed under isoflurane anaesthesia.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin significantly increased HTR in Cntnap2 -/- KO mice (F1/26 = 99.822, p < 0.001, Two-way ANOVA) with no significant effect of sex detected in our dataset

B1_num_measures.evidence: The number of head-twitch events was counted

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Counted in 5-minute bins, but no within-session time-course analysis is reported

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric

B5_social.evidence: Individual testing in a behavioural box

E3_bedding.evidence: the floor was covered with clean bedding

E4_nesting.evidence: Clean bedding only; no nesting material described

E6_spatial.evidence: The box is of size 40 ×20 X 20 cm

E7_social_context.evidence: each mouse was placed in a separate chamber to assess the head-twitch response

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the box

D2_session_duration.evidence: we assayed the HTR for a 20 min observation period

D3_recording_days.evidence: Immediately after psilocybin application, we assayed the HTR

D4_baseline.evidence: Recording began immediately after injection; no pre-drug baseline

D5_followup.evidence: HTR measured only during the acute 20-min window

assays.assay_description: Self-grooming episodes manually scored (blind observer) during the 10-min empty-apparatus habituation phases of the three-chamber test: the final habituation before drug treatment and the habituation phases of post-treatment tests at 1 day and 1 week.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: allowed to freely explore and habituate to the three-chamber setup for 10 minutes over 3 consecutive days

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to freely explore all three empty chambers for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the three-chamber apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the three-chamber apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: no significant difference in the number of self-grooming episodes displayed by Cntnap2 -/- KO mice at 1 day after psilocybin treatment... or at 1 week after treatment

sample_size.evidence: a; N = 11 for Cntnap2 -/- , 14 for Cntnap2 +/+ ... b; N = 6 for Cntnap2 -/- Psilocybin, 6 for Cntnap2 +/+ Vehicle

outcomes.summary: Cntnap2 -/- KO mice showed more self-grooming episodes than WT mice before treatment; psilocybin did not alter grooming in KO mice at 1 day or 1 week after treatment.
outcomes.statistics: Baseline KO vs WT U = 26, p = 0.005 (Mann-Whitney); 1 day KW = 0.235, p = 0.628; 1 week KW = 0.021, p = 0.886
outcomes.evidence: We therefore concluded that repetitive behaviour, although increased in Cntnap2 -/- KO mice, was not affected by psilocybin under our treatment conditions.

B4_ethological.evidence: We examined repetitive behaviour by quantifying self-grooming activity during habituation phases

B5_social.evidence: habituation phase of post-treatment three-chamber tests prior to the introduction of a social partner

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Episodes of grooming behaviour were manually scored by an experimenter who was blind to the genotyping and treatment conditions.

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed refuge in the three-chamber box

E6_spatial.evidence: divided in three smaller, evenly sized chambers... interconnected by 4 × 4 cm doors

E7_social_context.evidence: habituation phase... prior to the introduction of a social partner

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: the final habituation prior to drug treatment and the habituation phase of post-treatment three-chamber tests

D2_session_duration.evidence: each test animal was allowed to freely explore all three empty chambers for 10 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: pre-treatment final habituation, 1 day and 1 week after treatment

D4_baseline.evidence: Cntnap2 -/- KO mice displayed a significantly higher number of selfgrooming episodes compared to Cntnap2 +/+ WT mice during the final habituation session prior to drug treatments (Fig. 3a; U = 26, p = 0.005)

D5_followup.evidence: at 1 week after treatment (Fig. 3b, KW = 0.021, p = 0.886)

assays.assay_name: Locomotor activity (distance travelled) during three-chamber habituation
assays.assay_description: Distance travelled during the 10-min empty-apparatus habituation phases of the three-chamber test, tracked with DeepLabCut pose estimation (snout, ears, tail base) and MATLAB; genotype comparison and post-treatment comparisons at 1 day and 1 week.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: allowed to freely explore and habituate to the three-chamber setup for 10 minutes over 3 consecutive days

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to freely explore all three empty chambers for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the three-chamber apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the three-chamber apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: no significant difference was detected in the distance travelled by Cntnap2 -/- KO mice at 1 day after drug treatment... or at 1 week after drug treatment

sample_size.evidence: c; N = 22 for Cntnap2 -/- , 15 for Cntnap2 +/+ ... d; N = 12 for Cntnap2 -/- Psilocybin, 11 for Cntnap2 +/+ Vehicle

outcomes.summary: Cntnap2 -/- KO mice travelled more distance than WT mice (hyperactivity); psilocybin did not alter distance travelled in KO mice at 1 day or 1 week after treatment.
outcomes.statistics: KO vs WT U = 52, p < 0.001 (Mann-Whitney); 1 day KW = 0.458, p = 0.498; 1 week KW = 0.004, p = 0.951
outcomes.evidence: We therefore concluded that psilocybin has no effect on spontaneous locomotor drive under our treatment conditions.

B1_num_measures.evidence: distance travelled during the 10 min observation period

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological measure per rubric

B5_social.evidence: Measured during habituation without a social partner

B7_automated_classification.evidence: We used DeepLabCut to track the positions of the randomly selected test mouse during the habituation phase. Each mouse was labelled by a trained network to identify at least four body parts

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed refuge in the three-chamber box

E6_spatial.evidence: divided in three smaller, evenly sized chambers... interconnected by 4 × 4 cm doors

E7_social_context.evidence: habituation phases prior to the introduction of a social partner

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: we tracked the positions of the test mice during the habituation phases... at 1 day after drug treatment... or at 1 week after drug treatment

D2_session_duration.evidence: distance travelled during the 10 min observation period

D3_recording_days.evidence: habituation phases (pre-treatment genotype comparison), 1 day and 1 week after treatment

D4_baseline.evidence: Cntnap2 -/- KO mice displayed significantly higher distance travelled during the 10 min observation period compared to Cntnap2 +/+ isogenic wild-type mice (Fig. 3c) — genotype comparison during habituation phases including pre-treatment habituation

D5_followup.evidence: or at 1 week after drug treatment (Fig. 3d, KW = 0.004, p = 0.951)

judge_notes: Collapsed all sociability cohorts (KO, WT, heterozygous, independent 2-week cohort, MDL100907 pretreatment, anaesthesia treatment) into one three-chamber sociability assay per rubric.

Kept self-grooming and habituation-phase locomotion as separate assays (modal across deepseek4/gemma4): measured during the social-partner-free habituation phase and representing distinct behavioural domains (repetitive behaviour, hyperactivity).
Three-chamber B1 set to 1 (3 measures = 2-3 category); corrected gemma4's score of 2. B4 = Yes (manual scoring of sniffing/exploring the cup; 2/3 candidates).
HTR D2 corrected to 1 (20 min falls in 15-60 min); gemma4's 0 was an error. HTR B2 = 0 (5-min bins recorded but no time-course analysis reported; 2/3 candidates).

Grooming D4 = Yes: paper explicitly reports grooming data from the final habituation session prior to drug treatment. Locomotion D4 = Yes (medium confidence) by the same habituation-phase genotype comparison.
Locomotion B7 = 1 because DeepLabCut pose estimation is explicitly listed as score-1 in the rubric; the three-chamber test phase used position tracking plus manual timing, so B7 = 0 there.
application_type set to i.p. for the sociability assay (psilocybin and MDL100907 were both given i.p.); gemma4's 'multiple' rejected.
Added MDL100907 dosing entry (1 mg/kg i.p., 10% DMSO diluted in saline) since it was administered in behavioural experiments; isoflurane anaesthesia not listed as a dosing compound.
Three-chamber n_total of 126 sums the reported figure cohorts; overlap between groups (e.g., WT vehicle) is possible, so confidence is medium.
